in_force_since_evidence.quoted_span: Text of section as amended by 2025, 9, Sec. 43 effective August 1, 2025.

result.prior_version_note: Before August 1, 2025, the section only required that anyone in the business of finding dwelling accommodations for prospective tenants for a fee be a licensed broker or salesman. It contained no single-party contracting rule and no rule on who pays the fee. The licensing sentence carries over unchanged into the current text.
